Treatments I help with

The doctor chooses the method after a detailed eye examination.

  • 01

    Laser vision correction

    Methods such as LASIK, Femto-LASIK or SMILE for short-sightedness, long-sightedness and astigmatism.

  • 02

    PRK and LASEK

    Surface methods, sometimes recommended for thinner corneas.

  • 03

    Cataract surgery

    Removing the clouded lens and implanting an artificial one.

  • 04

    Lens replacement

    Refractive lens exchange, for example with a multifocal lens, when laser is not the best choice.

What your stay looks like

An example plan for laser vision correction. You get the exact plan after the consultation.

  1. Day 1

    Arrival

    I meet you at the airport and take you to the hotel.

  2. Day 2

    Examination

    A detailed eye examination that takes a few hours. The doctor decides on eligibility and method.

  3. Day 2–3

    Procedure

    The laser procedure itself is short. Afterwards you rest at the hotel.

  4. Day 3–4

    Check-up and going home

    A check-up with the doctor, usually the next day. The doctor decides when you can fly.

What to send for a first estimate

The more I know at the start, the more accurate your plan and quote. Just send this on WhatsApp.

  • Your current prescription
  • Whether you wear contact lenses, and which
  • Eye conditions and general health conditions
  • Medication you take
  • Your preferred travel dates
Send on WhatsApp

What I do

You have one contact person the whole time, speaking Polish, Ukrainian or Russian.

  • I choose the clinic and doctor for your case
  • I interpret every conversation with the doctor
  • I meet you at the airport and book your hotel and transfers
  • I am available 24/7 throughout your stay
  • We stay in touch after you get home

Questions about this treatment

Can't find your question? Message me and I'll reply within 24 hours.

Ask a question All questions
Do I need to stop wearing contact lenses?

Usually yes, for some time before the examination. How long depends on the type of lens. I will tell you after the consultation.

Can everyone have laser correction?

No. The doctor decides after the examination, including measuring the cornea. If laser is not right for you, the doctor will suggest another method.

When can I go home?

Usually after the check-up the day after the procedure. The doctor makes the final call.

Can I come on my own?

Yes. I meet you at the airport and stay with you at the clinic, so you do not need to bring anyone.
